diff --git a/.changeset/first-release.md b/.changeset/first-release.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.changeset/first-release.md
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+---
+'single-flight-auth': minor
+---
+
+First release: single-flight refresh within a tab, Web Locks (or a localStorage lease) across tabs,
+BroadcastChannel sync, `fetch` with a single 401 retry, and session-lost handling.
diff --git a/.github/workflows/release.yml b/.github/workflows/release.yml
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+name: Release
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+concurrency: release-${{ github.ref }}
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+  id-token: write
+
+jobs:
+  release:
+    name: Version or publish
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
+        with:
+          node-version: 24
+          cache: pnpm
+          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: pnpm check
+      - name: Open the version PR or publish to npm
+        uses: changesets/action@v1
+        with:
+          version: pnpm changeset version
+          publish: pnpm release
+          commit: 'chore: release'
+          title: 'chore: release'
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          # Trusted publishing (OIDC) needs no token; NPM_TOKEN is the fallback.
+          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
+          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
